content: Vite current stable is 8.3.0 (2026-09-11 registry check). Vite 7.0 (June 2025) introduced Rolldown as preview bundler, dropped Node 18 (requires 20.19+/22.12+), default browser target baseline-widely-available. @vitejs/plugin-react 6.1.1 supports React 19.2+ and oxc/react-compiler options. If a build step is ever adopted, Vite 8 + @vitejs/plugin-react is the standard pairing; no research flags.
